description: Asked which sorrow, and told him to be sorrier at the end.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Not in the room. The page goes with the canvas.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Called Alse off the stair after eight, and closed the house.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Took the canvas to the Bell, and left the ribbon as a trade if the king fails.
name: Gilbert Shakespeare

description: Wrote the four lines, and did not add a fifth.
name: William Shakespeare
